purpose: Locate an interruption or event right in the middle of an activity.
keywords: Verb ている + 最中に; noun + の最中に
The phone rang in the middle of the meeting.
The power went out while I was right in the middle of cooking.
It began raining in the middle of the match.
formation: Verb ている + 最中に; noun + の最中に
restrictions: Often introduces an unexpected or inconvenient event.
mistake: 最中 emphasizes being in the midst, more strongly than a general とき.
